comparable.definition: The two measurements refer to the same physical quantity, use compatible units and value kinds, have no unresolved calibration or metadata restriction, and require no unverified condition.
comparable.engine_behavior: Returned only when every required condition is verified.

conditionally_comparable.definition: The measurements can be compared only after one or more explicit conditions are verified, such as a documented fuel mapping, a normalized configuration label, or a stated measurement basis.
conditionally_comparable.engine_behavior: Returned when a rule exists but at least one required condition has not been supplied or verified.

not_comparable.definition: The measurements do not share a valid comparison basis, for example because they are different physical quantities, different categorical concepts, or different experiment families with no approved bridge.
not_comparable.engine_behavior: Returned for explicit not-comparable rules and by default when no rule exists. The default is never comparable.

blocked.definition: The measurements might share a physical basis, but a hard integrity constraint prevents comparison: an ambiguous unit, an uncalibrated raw signal, a missing measurement, or a measured versus computed conflict.
blocked.engine_behavior: Returned for explicit blocked rules and when the engine detects a hard unit, value-kind, calibration, availability, or quantity conflict.

insufficient_metadata.definition: The available metadata is not sufficient to decide whether a comparison is valid, for example an undefined acronym or an undocumented computation method.
insufficient_metadata.engine_behavior: Returned for explicit insufficient-metadata rules. Conditions cannot override this state.

default_policy.justification: No explicit comparison rule means no approved comparison. A matching column name, unit, or experiment family is not sufficient evidence.
default_policy.engine_behavior: Return not_comparable with a no_explicit_rule reason and never infer a comparison.

measurements.physical_meaning: Fuel identity label reported for the test row.
measurements.scientific_justification: Fuel identity is a source label, not a numeric measurement. PSI-10 normal rows use C2H4 or C3H8; inverse rows have no fuel label. It must not be mapped to PSI-159 blend labels without explicit chemistry.

measurements.physical_meaning: Normal or inverse flame configuration label.
measurements.scientific_justification: Configuration is a categorical experimental condition. Case variants in PSI-159 require normalization before grouping.

measurements.physical_meaning: Oxygen mole fraction of the oxidizer condition.
measurements.scientific_justification: Oxygen mole fraction is a controlled test condition reported by the source, not a sensor trace. Ramped and low-oxygen rows must be excluded from fixed-condition aggregation.

measurements.physical_meaning: Initial chamber pressure reported for the test.
measurements.scientific_justification: Initial pressure is a reported test condition. It is not interchangeable with the source-computed mean pressure column.

measurements.physical_meaning: Mean pressure reported by the source.
measurements.scientific_justification: The source reports a mean pressure; it is a computed summary, not an independent measurement. It must not be mixed with initial pressure without an explicit label.

measurements.physical_meaning: Fuel mass flow reported for the test condition.
measurements.scientific_justification: A reported test condition. Ramped rows are not fixed set points.

measurements.physical_meaning: Diluent mass flow reported for the test condition.
measurements.scientific_justification: A reported test condition. Ramped rows are not fixed set points.

measurements.physical_meaning: Total mass flow reported for the test condition.
measurements.scientific_justification: A reported test condition. Ramped rows are not fixed set points.

measurements.physical_meaning: Stoichiometric mixture fraction computed by the source.
measurements.scientific_justification: Computed by the source, not measured. The selected files do not document the computation method, so cross-investigation comparison is not approved.

measurements.physical_meaning: Adiabatic flame temperature computed by the source.
measurements.scientific_justification: Computed by the source, not a thermocouple reading. The computation method is not documented, so comparison with measured temperatures or with PSI-159 Tad is not approved.

measurements.physical_meaning: Approximate pressure converted by the source to bar.
measurements.scientific_justification: An approximate source conversion, not an independent measurement. It is not approved for quantitative comparison.

measurements.physical_meaning: Fuel or fuel-blend label reported for the test row.
measurements.scientific_justification: Fuel identity is a source label. PSI-159 includes pure fuels and percentage blends; these are not directly interchangeable with PSI-10 C2H4/C3H8 labels.

measurements.physical_meaning: Normal or inverse flame configuration label.

measurements.physical_meaning: Oxygen mole fraction of the oxidizer condition.

measurements.physical_meaning: Initial chamber pressure reported for the test.

measurements.physical_meaning: Burn time reported for the test.

measurements.scientific_justification: A measured result, distinct from computed Tad. The selected files do not document calibration; it must not be merged with the Kelvin column or compared with computed adiabatic temperatures.
